steps.headline: You are hired
steps.body: When a client hires you, you get a notification. Open it in My Work.
steps.narration: When a client hires you, you get a notification. Find the job in My Work. Good news travels fast.

steps.headline: Message client
steps.body: Tap Message client to agree on the details.
steps.narration: Tap Message client to agree on the details and say when you will arrive.

steps.headline: Change date or time
steps.body: Need another time? Open the menu and tap Change date or time.
steps.narration: Need another time? Open the menu and tap Change date or time. The client can accept or decline.

steps.headline: Start job
steps.body: When you arrive, tap Start job.
steps.narration: When you arrive, tap Start job.

steps.headline: Tasks
steps.narration: Now work through the task checklist. Each task has its own line.

steps.headline: Show the finished task
steps.body: Add one to four proof photos, then tap Mark as done.
steps.narration: For each task, add one to four proof photos. Then tap Mark as done.

steps.headline: Wait for confirmation
steps.body: When every task is done, the client confirms the job.
steps.narration: When every task is done, the client checks the work and confirms the job is done. Then you can relax.
steps.screenshot: placeholder:Provider Job details: all tasks done

steps.headline: Get paid
steps.body: Once confirmed, your pay is sent to your payout account.
steps.narration: Once confirmed, your pay is sent to your payout account.
